args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Water shoes
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Quick-dry beach cover-up

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy walking shoes
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Light jacket or rain jacket
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

Clothing:
- Casual outfits for daily wear
- Light, breathable clothing
- One nicer outfit for dinner/luau
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks
- Light sweater or jacket for cooler evenings

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Headphones

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Prescription medications
- Contact lenses and solution (if applicable)
- Lip balm with SPF

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)

Special Activity Items:
- Pearl Harbor: Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- Luau: Hawaiian shirt or dress (optional but fun)
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Shopping: Reusable shopping bags

Remember to check weather forecasts before departure and adjust accordingly!
